games.name: Labyrinth
games.description: Find your way through a randomly generated maze. Each level grows larger — how deep can you go?

games.name: Wind & Earth
games.description: Co-op platformer in a ruined world. Guide the spirits of Earth and Wind through procedurally chained chambers — each survives where the other cannot, only together can they pass.
controls: Earth — A/D move, W stone pillar (self), S stone pillar (under Wind). No jump.
Wind — Arrows move, ↑ wind boost (self), ↓ wind boost (under Earth). No jump.

games.name: Cookie Clicker
games.description: Click the cookie to bake cookies. Spend them on buildings and upgrades to automate production and multiply your output!

games.name: Cave Balloon
games.description: Pilot a blue hot air balloon through a rocky cave. Tap or press Space to float up and dodge the stalactites and stalagmites!

games.name: Shark Waves
games.description: Ride endless procedural waves as a shark. Dive into the slope, launch off the crest, eat seagulls for speed, dodge boats — and don't let your momentum die or something hungry comes up from the deep.
controls: Release at the crest to breach
Land on a descending wave for a Perfect Slide
